resources.title: RFC 5944 - IP Mobility Support for IPv4, Revised
resources.description: The current Mobile IPv4 specification: agent discovery, registration, tunneling, mobility bindings.

resources.title: RFC 3344 - IP Mobility Support for IPv4
resources.description: The earlier Mobile IPv4 specification, kept for historical reference. Use RFC 5944 for the current text.

resources.title: RFC 2003 - IP Encapsulation within IP
resources.description: Defines IP-in-IP: how an outer IP header is added around an original datagram and removed at the tunnel exit.

resources.title: RFC 3024 - Reverse Tunneling for Mobile IP, revised
resources.description: Explains reverse tunneling from the care-of address to the home agent, and why it avoids ingress-filtering and triangle-routing problems.

resources.title: Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF)
resources.description: The standards body behind the RFCs; starting point for finding and following internet standards.

resources.title: Cisco Networking Academy
resources.description: Structured networking courses: IP addressing, routing, switching and network fundamentals.

resources.title: Cloudflare Learning Center
resources.description: Short, readable explainers on networking concepts such as IP addresses, DNS, TCP/UDP and tunneling.

resources.title: GeeksforGeeks: Computer Networks
resources.description: Tutorial articles on computer-network topics (layers, addressing, routing, error control) with worked examples.

resources.title: Data Communications and Networking
resources.description: A widely used first textbook on data communication and networking.
resources.covers: Layer-by-layer coverage from signals and modulation up to the application layer, with many worked examples. A good first book for an ECE data communication course.
resources.note: No verified publisher link was available when this list was prepared. Check your library or the publisher's website for the current edition.

resources.title: Computer Networking: A Top-Down Approach
resources.authors: James F. Kurose and Keith W. Ross
resources.description: A top-down textbook that starts from applications and works down to the link layer.
resources.covers: Starts with applications and works down to the link layer, with a strong treatment of transport, routing and wireless/mobile networks.
resources.note: No verified publisher link was available when this list was prepared. Check your library or the publisher's website for the current edition.

resources.title: Computer Networks
resources.authors: Andrew S. Tanenbaum and David J. Wetherall (newer editions list additional authors)
resources.description: A layered, in-depth textbook on computer networks.
resources.covers: Follows the layers from physical to application, with detailed explanations of protocols and design trade-offs. Good for depth after a first course.
resources.note: Newer editions may list additional authors. Check your library or the publisher's website for the current edition; no verified link was available here.
